Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
tenis
Wikipedia es
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
calzado deportivo
Wikipedia es

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English tennis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈtenis/ [ˈt̪e.nis]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -enis
  • Syllabification: te‧nis

Noun

[edit]

tenis m (uncountable)

  1. tennis

Noun

[edit]

tenis m (plural tenis)

  1. (Andalusia, Canary Islands, Latin America, footwear) sneaker, trainer, tennis shoe (an athletic shoe).
    Synonyms: zapatillas, zapatilla de deporte, deportivos, deportivas, bambas, playeros, playeras

Usage notes

[edit]
  • When referring to shoes, it is usually used in the plural form (los tenis).
  • In most of central and northern Spain, the term zapatillas de deporte, deportivas, or simply zapatillas is more common, whereas tenis is the standard everyday term in Andalusia, the Canary Islands, and most of Latin America.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • bola de tenis
  • cancha de tenis
  • colgar los tenis
  • pelota de tenis
  • pista de tenis
  • tenis de mesa m
  • tenista m or f by sense
  • tenístico m, tenística f

Further reading

[edit]
  • “tenis”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
